# BigQuery rejects a generated-style name when it is specified explicitly in CREATE TABLE
# (bqanswers, johejo-sandbox, run kmscjotrjyjxjykmntohxhme6z, create_collision).
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_create_collision;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_create_collision.parent (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE TABLE bqa_fk_create_collision.child (a INT64, b INT64,
  FOREIGN KEY (b) REFERENCES bqa_fk_create_collision.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED,
  CONSTRAINT `fk$1` FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_create_collision.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED)
=> error contains: Invalid field name "fk$1". Fields must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores, start with a letter or underscore, and be at most 300 characters long.
